channel.title: AB Peace — Agnostic Vibe Coder & Systems Hacker
channel.description: Original dispatches on vibe coding, sub-10ms latency loops, context poisoning, and bespoke engineering craft in late 2026 by AB Peace.

item.title: The 2026 Phase Shift: Why I Stopped Writing Code by Hand
item.description: We spent thirty years treating keystrokes as the coin of engineering realm. In late 2026, when implementation cost is effectively zero, architecture and taste are the only things left standing.

item.title: The Sub-10ms Feedback Loop: Playing Code Like an Instrument
item.description: Why waiting 15 seconds for an AI response induces cognitive death, and how multi-branch speculative execution turns software creation into improvisational jazz.

item.title: Context Poisoning and The Art of Strategic Forgetting
item.description: Frontier models in late 2026 advertise multi-million token context windows. In reality, large contexts make models stupid. Here is how I build systems that aggressively forget.

item.title: In Praise of Bespoke Digital Artifacts in the Age of Infinite Slop
item.description: When AI can generate an entire corporate SaaS platform in forty seconds, generic software becomes worthless. The future belongs to hyper-specific, weird personal tools built with love.
